positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Embedded Team

Embedded / Cross-Platform development for offline and hybrid on-device voice Al solutions, including platforms such as automotive and low-power Linux devices, as well as associated developer productivity tools.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software · Embedded Linux · Bash · Jenkins · CentOS · Vim · Git · C++ · Python (Programming Language) · Cross-platform Development · CMake

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Implemented unit and stress tests to validate the JPEG kernel driver for the camera architecture. Worked primarily in C and C++.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked on projects with RF Software group. Helped to make a RF testing tool faster and more user-oriented through queuing test commands and allowing easier modification on test plan. Gained a general understanding of test plans, wireless testing, and wireless communications, and  expanded computer languages to include experience in C#, WPF, and XMLs/Schemas.

positions.title: Music Signal Processing Research Project
positions.description: Collaborated with a UIUC Professor (ECE and Music Departments) on a research project. Researched, implemented and optimized a project that took in an audio file, and used different pitch detection methods to calculate and display the changing pitch of soloists (alto saxophone, vocal tenor, trumpet). The different pitch detection algorithms and methods that were used include autocorrelation and FFT. This project was mainly implemented in C.

positions.title: DECA Attendee
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description: DECA aims to provide professional development opportunities for underrepresented engineering students from the nation's top universities. The conference weekend includes engineering challenges, campus tours, developmental activities (including workshops and a hackathon), and exposure to some leading Qualcomm technologies. The students build their network by meeting mentors and other talented students from across the country in San Diego.

honors.title: ECE Visionary Scholarship
honors.issuer: Issued by UIUC Electrical and Computer Engineering department

projects.title: Q-Hacks Project
projects.description: During Q-Hacks, a hackathon taking place during the DECA conference, worked on a project to better the subway transportation system. The project involved a combination of front and back end development. A pressure sensor detected whether a given seat was occupied, and it transmitted the data from an Arduino via Bluetooth to the app. The app organized and displayed the information as open seats in a given subway car.

organizations.name: Women's Glee Club
organizations.description: A member of the University of Illinois's Women's Glee Club. Participates in rehearsals and choral concerts with about 70 other women.
